originalTitle: US stocks today: Nasdaq jumps over 1% as chip stocks rally, investors eye AI earnings
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the US stock market: the Nasdaq, a collection of technology stocks, went up by over 1% today. This is because companies that make computer chips, like Broadcom, are doing well and investors are feeling optimistic about their future, especially with the growing use of artificial intelligence (AI). However, not all stocks did well - Microsoft's stock went down after they announced they're cutting jobs. Investors are also waiting to see what happens with interest rates, which is why they're looking closely at upcoming company earnings reports and news from the Federal Reserve (the "Fed"). This will help them figure out what to do with their investments.

originalTitle: NY Fed says supply chain pressures eased in June
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: the New York Fed, which is like a bank that helps the US economy, is saying that problems with getting goods from one place to another are getting a little better. This is measured by something called the New York Fed index, which went down to 1.25 in June. This matters because it might help reduce inflation, which is when prices for things like food and gas go up. The good news is that things are moving more smoothly through a important waterway called the Strait of Hormuz, and oil prices are also going down, which should help. However, there are still some delays and problems in the system, so things aren't completely back to normal yet.

originalTitle: EasyJet shares reveal deal risk as $7.3 billion takeover advances
simplifiedContent: EasyJet, an airline company, has agreed to be taken over by another company called Castlelake for £5.5 billion. As a result, the price of EasyJet shares went up, but not as high as the takeover offer, which means some investors are still worried about the deal. There are concerns about whether the takeover will be approved by regulators and if the company's shareholders will agree to it. The buyer, Castlelake, has until August 3 to finalize its offer. This news matters because it affects the value of EasyJet shares, and investors are waiting to see if the takeover will happen.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold tops $4,200, silver nears $64 as recovery rally extends; Fed minutes in focus
simplifiedContent: The prices of gold and silver went up a little on July 6th. This happened because people are less worried that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, and the value of the US dollar went down. As a result, gold futures reached $4,215 and silver reached $63.73, which is a comeback from their previous losses. This is important because it shows that investors are feeling more positive about gold and silver. The prices of these metals may continue to be affected by upcoming news from the Federal Reserve, which investors are waiting to hear.

originalTitle: Trent Q1 business update: Revenue grows 19%, store network expands
simplifiedContent: Trent, a company owned by the Tata Group, had a good first quarter with its sales growing 19% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹5,666 crore. The company also opened more stores, now having a total of 1,312 outlets. This news caused the company's stock price to go up, increasing by 17.2% in 2026, although it's still not as high as it was at its peak. This matters because it shows that the company is growing and expanding, which can be a good sign for investors. The increase in stock price is also a positive sign for people who already own shares of the company.

originalTitle: Rentomojo gets SEBI nod for raising funds through IPO launch. Details here
simplifiedContent: Rentomojo, a company that rents out furniture, has gotten approval from a group called SEBI to sell stocks to the public for the first time. This is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO) and the company wants to raise up to ₹150 crore. The money will be used to expand the business and pay off debts. Existing shareholders, or people who already own a part of the company, will be selling some of their shares as part of the IPO. This matters because it shows that Rentomojo is growing and has a significant presence in the online rental market in India.
